name: kiff
displayName: KIFF: your agent's Card and held calls, in Claude Code
description: Beta, optional. Shows what is left on the agent's KIFF Card in the status line, says when KIFF holds a call and when the owner answers it, and lists this session's KIFF calls in a /kiff pane. It never answers, retries or changes a call: once the owner answers, it tells the agent in one turn, and the agent decides whether to call again. Use with kiff-cards.
